name: Rambutan
siboNotes: Well-tolerated tropical fruit option for SIBO diets due to low FODMAP content and natural enzymes that may aid digestion.
preparationTips: Peel the hairy outer skin to reveal the translucent flesh inside
Remove the seed before eating - only consume the white flesh
Choose fruits that yield slightly to pressure but aren't mushy
Store ripe rambutans in refrigerator for up to one week
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin C for immune support
Contains copper for healthy connective tissue
Good source of manganese for bone health
